definitions.explanation: The hole made in the earlobe or another body part for wearing pierced jewelry.

examples.japanese: ピアス{穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
ピアス{穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がって→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The piercing hole has closed up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ピアス{穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がる→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't wear earrings for a long time, the piercing hole can close up.

notes:
USAGE: ピアス{穴|あな} is the hole for pierced jewelry, combining ⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧ (pierced earring) with ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧ (hole). Note that ⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧ in Japanese refers specifically to *pierced* accessories, unlike clip-on ⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピアス{穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to get a piercing (make the hole)
- ピアス{穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がる→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧: for the piercing hole to close

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧: pierced earring — the jewelry itself
- ⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧: clip-on earring — the non-pierced type
